kind: prospective gate amendment (additive; executed verdicts unchanged; results/generic_substrate_v2_spec.json is sealed and left unedited)
reviewer_decision: ISI criteria apply only to active cells, but the active-cell fraction must itself be gated. Silent cells are not counted as ISI failures and are not excluded without an activity-fraction gate.
rationale: without an activity gate a model can raise its class ISI fraction or E rate-CV by silencing difficult neurons

operation.active_cell: a neuron with >= min_spikes spikes in one analysis window, min_spikes from the isi_cv_by_class check (4 in a 5 s window: r_min,cell = 0.8 Hz). Identical to the amendment 1 CV-evaluable definition
operation.active_fraction: for each class X in {E, PV, SST, VIP} separately: f_active = N_X(active) / N_X, in every analysis window
operation.gate: f_active >= 0.95 for every class in every analysis window
operation.isi: unchanged: P(0.5 <= CV_ISI <= 1.5 | active) >= 0.8 per class (amendment 1)
operation.rate_cv: unchanged: E rate-CV over all E neurons, silent included

threshold_source: reviewer choice 2026-09-16; carries results/v21c_design_protocol.json F3_silence (E fraction with <4 spikes <= 0.05, a design criterion) to all four classes as a gate
profile: prospective_v2 in manifests/gates/v2_local_operation.json (check active_fraction_by_class); historical_v21_battery unchanged
